title: China visa
tagline: Tourist, business and student visas to the People’s Republic of China.
intro:
China is one of the most popular routes from Kyrgyzstan — tourism, sourcing, trade fairs and study. Each purpose has its own visa category and document set.

We complete the online form, prepare the invitation or bookings, review your documents and book your submission.
services: Help with an invitation from a Chinese company
Hotel bookings and itinerary for a tourist visa
X1/X2 student visa with JW202 and admission letter

sections.heading: Which visa do you need
sections.body:
- **L** — tourism and visiting friends.
- **M** — business trips, trade fairs, sourcing (invitation required).
- **X1** — study longer than 180 days (admission letter + JW202 form).
- **X2** — short-term study and language courses up to 180 days.
- **Q / S** — visiting relatives living in China.

documents: Passport valid at least 6 months with blank pages
Photo meeting the visa centre’s requirements
Bookings or invitation — depending on visa type
For study: admission letter and JW202
Copies of previous Chinese visas (if any)

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We determine the visa category and timeline.

steps.title: Documents and form
steps.text: We complete the form and prepare bookings or the invitation.

steps.title: Submission
steps.text: We book the visa centre and check the package before you submit.

steps.title: Visa pickup
steps.text: We let you know when it is ready and help with entry questions.

faq.q: How long does a China visa take?
faq.a: Usually a few working days; express processing is available for an extra fee. We confirm exact timing at submission.

faq.q: Do I need an invitation for a business visa?
faq.a: Yes, an M visa requires an invitation from the host company in China. We tell you what it must contain.

faq.q: Can I study in China on a tourist visa?
faq.a: No. Study requires an X1 or X2 student visa. If you apply through us, we handle everything from admission to the visa.
